subject: Mutual calendar handshake — two narrowed 30m windows + infra ask

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 29 May 2026 15:02:10 -0700
Subject: Mutual calendar handshake — two narrowed 30m windows + infra ask

Hi Samira / Ben —

Great to meet you both on today’s discovery. Quick recap and an ask so we don’t lose momentum:

- What went well: clear drivers (reduce inference cost, predictable latency across environments), two priority use cases identified (support chat and document summarization).
- Open items for the next call: 1) product demo (30m) to show flow+ops; 2) short infra Q&A to validate network/KMS constraints.

To keep this tight, could you pick one of these two 30-minute options for the intro demo (all times PT):

A) Tue 1 Jun — 10:00–10:30 PT
B) Wed 2 Jun — 16:00–16:30 PT

If neither works, please propose up to two alternate 30-minute windows and note which internal stakeholders should join from your side (SRE/Infra / Security / Product).

I’ve attached a short draft agenda and our proposed mutual action plan so you can see what we’d cover in 30 minutes. If you want Rishi or Priyom on the call (they can run the technical deep dive), I’ll add them when we lock time.

Attachments: draft_demo_agenda.pdf, mutual-action-plan.xlsx

Thanks — looking forward to locking a slot.

Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0193

Thanks, Jonas — good session today. We’re keen to see the flow end-to-end.

Quick scheduling note: Tue 1 Jun at 10am PT conflicts with a board prep, but Wed 2 Jun 16:00 PT looks promising. Two quick asks before we lock:

1) Can you include a short 10-minute slot at the end for infra/network Q&A? Our SRE (Javier Morales) needs to validate VPC peering and KMS requirements.
2) Could you share any pre-read on perf/cost assumptions? A one-pager or bullet list is fine.

If Rishi or Priyom can join for the infra Q&A, that would be ideal. We may also add our security director to the invite depending on answers.
